candidates.concept: Skeleton Crew — a CMDB / reconciliation viewer run by a minimal crew: a tiny set of spec-first Kiro agents (ingest, reconcile, report) that keep a fleet inventory honest against its sources. The challenge lane's hand-noted input (input, not decision). Seeded from the repo's CMDB design (PR #1655); the Kiro project itself is created new inside the submission window.

Frankenstein — one new creature stitched from proven public parts: a Kiro-built decision agent assembled from the fleet's existing public patterns (Delphi Oracle deterministic receipts, the fetch_evidence provenance tool pattern from the D0 package, quota-panel display patterns), re-combined into a single new project created inside the window. Patterns are reused; no pre-built project is submitted.

Resurrection — bring a dormant public spec back from the dead: pick a stalled, publicly documented fleet spec (candidates sit in the repo's ops docs and proposal registry) and rebuild it fresh as a working Kiro project, created in-window, with the original spec as the requirements baseline and a resurrection report showing what the dead version never shipped.

enforcement: The D4 brief/intake REFUSES any build start before window_open: no project creation, no building (owner ruling 2026-10-27 — eligibility enforced mechanically, per entry, per producing lane).
At project creation, the creation timestamp is captured into packet D4 as eligibility evidence; a timestamp before window_open voids the entry.
The generated concept proposal is not the competition project and does not trip this gate.
eligibility_gate.owner_confirmation: 2026-10-27: D4's build waits for its window.
eligibility_gate.rule: New Projects Only (Official Rules s.4, kiroween.devpost.com/rules, read 2026-10-30): Projects must be newly created by the Entrant after the start of the Hackathon Submission Period (Oct 30, 2026, 9:00 AM PT). Standard development resources (frameworks, libraries, starter templates) may be used; any other pre-existing code or work incorporated must be disclosed. The work described and submitted must have been built during the Submission Period.

round_1.ranking_basis: TIE - identical LOCAL_BASELINE scores (23.269) on identical scored profile dimensions; the recorded ranked_outcome order is the rank() tie-break by candidate id, not an evidence preference
